data.one_liner: A simple multiselect dropdown widget with search and select-all options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a multiselect dropdown component supporting both simple lists and lists of maps. Includes built-in search and select-all options with customizable styling parameters.
use_when: You need a dropdown component that allows selecting multiple items from a list.
You want built-in search and select-all capabilities within a dropdown.
Your data source is either a simple list of strings or a list of maps.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation integration beyond standard callbacks.
strengths: Supports both simple lists and lists of maps
Includes built-in search with debounce and select-all options
Highly customizable styling (box decoration, text styles, checkbox colors)
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic parameters and a single usage example
No explicit form field validation handling documented
data.minimal_example:
MultiSelectDropdown.simpleList(
  list: const ['Dog', 'Cat', 'Mouse', 'Rabbit'],
  initiallySelected: const [],
  onChange: (newList) {},
  includeSearch: true,
  includeSelectAll: true,
);
